title: Lightning Became 40 Times Less Deadly Per Person
hook: Lightning's per-person death risk fell 40-fold, but exposed people still die.
closing: Lower risk does not make an exposed spot safe; take thunder as a cue to get indoors.
question: Where do you shelter during thunderstorms?

segments.say: The latest supplied annual count is 18 lightning deaths. Fatalities fell sharply from the historical average.
Per-person lightning death risk fell 40-fold across the compared eras. The improvement remains dramatic after accounting for population.
Fishing accounts for 10% of recent lightning deaths in these data. Exposure near open water remains a serious concern.
